name: CAD & Parametric Solid Modeling
summary: Building 3D parametric part and assembly models, generating drawings and managing design data in modern CAD systems.

topics.name: CAD landscape: parametric, direct and cloud CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion, Onshape, NX, CATIA, Creo)
Sketches, geometric constraints and design intent
Feature-based modeling: extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet, shell, patterns
Assemblies: mates/joints, top-down vs bottom-up design, interference checking
Motion studies and mechanism simulation inside CAD
Standard part libraries and purchased components
Mass properties and basic in-CAD simulation
File formats and interoperability (STEP, IGES, STL, 3MF, Parasolid)
Product data management (PDM/PLM), revision control and model-based definition (MBD)
